walkthrough: Goal: take part of my drawing and put a copy of it elsewhere, move a part out of a layer, and get everything I see as one layer, as Procreate's Copy & Paste does; each is one undo step and reopening keeps it.

Entry: open OpenPaint on the tablet (2880 x 1800, landscape) on an empty library and draw a black wave with the pen on Layer 1. Tap Selection, Rectangle, and drag a rectangle round the wave's middle with the pen.

Open the menu: swipe three fingers down on the canvas (about a finger's width, quickly). A pill appears just under the islands (the selection bar holds the top band's middle) with Cut, Copy, Copy All, Duplicate, Cut & Paste and Paste as words; Paste is pencil grey, as nothing is copied yet. The same menu opens from Actions > Copy & Paste, whose row says Three fingers down. A three-finger tap still redoes and two fingers still pan, pinch and turn: only fingers moved together straight down at least 48 points within 0.8 s open the menu.

Copy: tap Copy. The pill goes; nothing on the canvas changes. Swipe again: Paste is ink now. Tap Paste: a new layer Pasted layer appears above Layer 1 holding exactly what the rectangle held, where it was, and the Transform tool is on at once (its ring, the frame round the pasted part, Flip, Rotate 45° and Reset in the top band). Drag inside the frame with the pen: the copy moves. Tap Transform: it stays there and the selection goes. Undo: the pasted layer goes in one step; redo brings it back where it was placed.

Cut: choose Layer 1 in Layers, select another rectangle across the wave, and open the menu from Actions > Copy & Paste. Tap Cut: the selected part of the wave leaves Layer 1 (the selection stays, now over nothing). Undo brings it back, redo cuts again. Cut & Paste cuts and pastes in one step, Duplicate copies and pastes in one step.
Copy All: Deselect, swipe, tap Copy All, swipe, tap Paste: a new layer shows the wave and the moved copy together as one picture, framed; tap Transform to keep it.

Failure: Cut and Cut & Paste are grey on a hidden, locked or empty layer, Copy and Duplicate on an empty one, Copy All when nothing shows; Paste is grey with nothing copied or a copy from a canvas of another size. Pasting a selection that held no paint says 'Nothing to paste: the copy holds no paint.' with OK and adds nothing.
Cancel: a tap on the canvas outside the pill closes it; nothing changes.

Reopen: leave the app and let the system close it, open it again: the pasted layers and the cut are as left. What was copied does not survive the app's end: the clipboard lives for the app's run only (not stored, not the system clipboard).
